Homepage style guide · Version 7 · Final

Neon Sweeps
Style Guide

This guide documents the finished homepage of the US sweepstakes casino so designers and developers can rebuild it and extend it to new pages. It covers colour, type, borders, buttons, image style and every homepage section, top to bottom.

The source of truth is the latest full homepage (with Jackpots and the 96%+ RTP panel). Three close-ups add detail: High RTP Games (game cards only), New Games and Favourite Characters. Where a close-up and the homepage disagree, the homepage wins. Anything no longer on the page has been removed.

Desktop canvas 1440pxContainer ≈ 1290pxDark theme onlyCopyable HEX & CSS
How to read the values. Sampled means the colour was read from a pixel in the screenshot. Matched means it was matched by eye, because glows, gradients and fonts can't be recovered exactly from a flat image. Sizes are measured from the screenshot and scaled to a 1440px canvas, so treat them as ±4px.
Corrections

What changed from v5

v5 was written while the page was still in progress. These are all the corrections made since, checked against the latest homepage.

Fixed
Section order. Game Providers moved from under Promotions to near the bottom, after VIP Club. See the full order under Page anatomy.
Fixed
Game Shows. The charcoal #1B1B22 panel, borderless cards and plain-text View All are gone. Game Shows now uses the same neon pill header, purple View All and arrows as every other section, with neon-bordered wide cards.
Fixed
Card shapes. Promotions are ≈2:1 (was 1.55:1). Casino and Live Casino are ≈2:1 (was 4:3). Favourite Characters are ≈2.1:1 on the homepage (was 1.62:1). High RTP game cards are nearly square at ≈1.15:1 (was portrait 2:3).
Fixed
Hero. The hero is a carousel with round side arrows and three dots. It has a two-tone eyebrow, a four-item feature row (Slots, Live Casino, Big Wins, Instant Play) and an Active Players card. The headline is a wide, heavy geometric sans, not a condensed face.
Updated
Fonts. Montserrat and Barlow Condensed are replaced by Inter (Headings H1–H4, live amounts) and Poppins (Subheadings, Body, hero, banners and buttons), following the approved type sheet. See Typography.
Updated
High RTP panel. The info panel now reads 96%+ as one large gold figure. The laurel wreath and the words "RTP" and "GAMES" are gone. The close-up (reference 2) still shows the old 97%+ panel and is kept only for the game cards.
New
Jackpots. A Full Moon Jackpots banner now sits between Game Shows and High RTP Games: headline and CTA on the left, a howling wolf and full moon in the middle, and Mini, Grand and Major prize boxes in Sweeps Coins on the right. See Jackpots.
Updated
Promotions art. Welcome Bonus now shows two playing cards and a chip inside a pink neon ring. Penguin King shows a gold and purple crown. The offer line reads "SPEND $9.99 25K GC + 25 SC".
Updated
Small details. News ticker items are separated by gold dots, with no icons. Category nav icons are gold, with the active one in cyan. Explore Games and every character Play Now button end in an arrow (→). Active Players reads 29,900+.
New
Eight new homepage blocks in total: Casino, Jackpots, New Games, VIP Club banner, AI Game Search, FAQ, SEO content block, and a footer with a hot-pink legal bar.
New
Providers grid is now 6 × 3 (18 logos). Spribe, Penguin King, Animo, Big Daddy, Fantasma and Icon21 were added.
Removed
Recent Winners, the old gold three-tier Jackpot Winners panel (replaced by the new Jackpots banner), the four aubergine promo-art references, the portrait game-cover reference and the old Game Shows screenshot.
Text errors in the screenshot. Some labels in the latest homepage image are garbled by the image generator. They are not design changes, so build them with the correct text: the Shadow Blade badge reads "NOT" (use HOT); High RTP cards read "Lucky Fortune" and "Vamory Rush" (use Lucky Clover and Diamond Rush); several New Games logos are scrambled (use the names in reference 3); and the two secondary buttons in the Jackpots banner have unreadable labels (see Jackpots for suggested wording).
Structure

Page anatomy

The homepage is one centred column. Every content section after the category nav opens with the same section header, so the page reads as a rhythm of header → row of cards.

  1. Header
  2. News ticker
  3. Hero carousel
  4. Category nav
  5. Promotions · 3
  6. Popular Games · 4
  7. Casino · 4
  8. Favourite Characters · 3
  9. Live Casino · 4
  10. Game Shows · 3
  11. Jackpots banner
  12. High RTP · panel + 4
  13. New Games · 8
  14. VIP Club banner
  15. Game Providers · 6×3
  16. AI Game Search
  17. FAQ
  18. SEO content block
  19. Footer
  20. Legal bar

The number after each name is how many cards sit in a row at desktop width. Rows of 3 use wide (≈2:1) cards, rows of 4 use medium cards, and New Games uses 8 portrait tiles. This mix of rhythms is deliberate. Keep it when you add sections.

Part 1

Foundations

Foundations

Colour

A near-black navy ground with two neon accents that do almost all the work: cyan for action (CTAs, active states, left edge of borders) and magenta for energy (badges, right edge of borders, footer). Purple ties them together in gradients and glows. Gold is for VIP and RTP only. Click any chip to copy its HEX.

Core UI

Neon accents

Jackpot tiers

Card accent colours

Cards with a solid colour background (New Games) or a themed border (High RTP, Favourite Characters) take their border colour from the artwork's dominant hue. Use these values so the same hues repeat across sections.

Foundations

Gradients & glow

Gradients run left to right, and go from cool to warm: cyan on the left, magenta on the right. Glows are soft, short and coloured, never white or grey. Two glows of different colour on either side of an element are the signature effect of this site.

Foundations

Typography

Two families, both free on Google Fonts. Inter sets the Headings: clean, even capitals at a regular weight. Poppins sets Subheadings and Body: its round, geometric letters carry the friendly, playful side of the brand. Poppins' heavy weights (700–800) also set the hero, banner titles and buttons, which need more punch than the regular-weight styles on the sheet. The scale below comes from the approved type sheet.

Why amounts use Inter. Inter has true tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), so jackpot amounts and balances keep the same width as they tick up. Poppins does not.
Text inside artwork. Game names on Casino, Live Casino, Game Shows, High RTP, New Games and character cards are game logos, and they are part of the image. They use each game's own lettering, not Inter or Poppins. Don't place HTML titles on top of them.

Part 2

Imagery

Imagery

Image style

All game and promo art follows one look: glossy, high-contrast 3D illustration lit by neon. Every image uses the same recipe. Each point below can be seen in the approved examples.

Always

  • One clear subject: a character, a dealer, or a single symbol (book, 7, clover, diamond).
  • Neon rim light in the card's accent colour. Light trails or sparks curl around the subject.
  • Deep background: navy, black-violet, or one saturated hue for New Games.
  • Rich, saturated colour with crisp highlights on gold, gems and coins.
  • Friendly, confident characters looking at the viewer, from the chest up.
  • Game logo in the lower third (tiles) or upper right (character cards).

Never

  • Photographs, flat vector art or muted colour.
  • Buttons, prices, coin amounts, RTP numbers or player counts inside the image.
  • A border or glow drawn into the image. Borders are always CSS.
  • Imitations of a real provider's game art. Licensed titles use the provider's own approved assets.
  • Cash, cards or chips shown as real-money prizes. This is a sweepstakes site (see wording).
  • Stretching. Crop to the ratio instead.

Generation brief (for new in-house art)

Premium casino game illustration, glossy high-detail 3D render, one clear subject
[CHARACTER / DEALER / SYMBOL], dramatic neon rim lighting in [ACCENT COLOUR],
curling light trails and small sparks, deep [NAVY / BLACK-VIOLET / SATURATED ACCENT]
background, rich saturated colour, crisp metallic highlights on gold and gems,
subject placed [LEFT HALF for character cards | CENTRED for tiles],
leave [RIGHT 45% | LOWER THIRD] calm for the game logo and HTML button.
No text except the game logo. No buttons, prices, RTP numbers, borders or watermarks.

Homepage sections

Section · site chrome

Header & news ticker

Header · 72px

Left: a 24px menu icon, then the logo (wordmark, white, Poppins 800). Right: the wallet pill (coin icon, balance, chevron; 1px #233650, 12px radius, #061326 fill) and the Deposit button. Transparent background over #000816, with no bottom border.

News ticker · 46px

A full-width pill with a 1.5px cyan-to-violet border. "NEWS:" in cyan Poppins 700 with a megaphone icon, then items separated by small gold dots #F4CC1D. Items are plain white Body S (Poppins 14px / 500) with no icons. A » control on the right. Scroll the text slowly, pause it on hover and focus, and stop it for reduced motion.

Game Shows

This replaces the v5 charcoal design. It uses the standard section header and three ≈ 2 : 1 cards in a row. Each card has a 2px magenta/violet border, 14px radius and magenta glow.

In the art, a presenter holding a microphone stands in front of the show's wheel or board. The game logo is at the bottom centre, and the lower 40% fades to purple. The fade is in the art; don't add a second CSS overlay.

Section · feature banner · new in v7

Jackpots

One full-width banner under the standard section header. It is the most theatrical block on the page, so keep everything around it calm.

LayerSpec
BannerContainer width, ≈ 280px high, 16px radius. 2px neon-edge border (cyan top-left to purple bottom-right) with split glow. Fill: deep navy on the left fading to electric blue-violet #1A1680 behind the moon.
Eyebrow"STEP INTO OUR WORLD OF", white, 16px / 700 uppercase.
Headline"FULL MOON" white and "JACKPOTS" in violet #B26BFF, two lines, Poppins 800, ≈ 44px, line height 1.
Tagline"Massive Prizes, Life-Changing Wins, And Non-Stop Action!" in muted 13px, max two lines.
ButtonsPrimary: Play Jackpot Games →, CTA gradient, 8px radius. Secondary: ghost button, 1.5px violet border, white text + →. The secondary label is unreadable in the screenshot; suggested: Jackpot Rules →.
ArtA howling wolf on a rock in front of a glowing full moon, with blue lightning and purple mist. Centre of the banner, between the text and the prize boxes. Supplied as one transparent-edged image.
Prize boxesThree boxes in the order Mini · Grand · Major. Grand is the largest and sits slightly higher. Each has a 2px border and glow in its tier colour, a near-black fill, a 12px radius, and an icon that overlaps the top edge: pink crown (Mini), gold crown (Grand), cyan gem (Major).
Prize textTier name in its colour, Poppins 700, 22px. Amount in white/gold, Inter 700, 22px (Grand 26px), tabular numbers, with the "SC" prefix.
Bottom stripThe screenshot shows a faint row of extra buttons along the bottom edge with unreadable labels. Leave it out, or use it for one text link such as "How jackpots work →".
Prize amounts must come from the live jackpot feed and update in place. Show them in Sweeps Coins (SC), never in dollars, and link the banner to the jackpot rules.
.jackpot-tier{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;
  gap:4px;padding:26px 20px 14px;border:2px solid var(--tier);
  border-radius:12px;background:#07040F;
  box-shadow:0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tier) 70%,transparent),
             inset 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tier) 25%,transparent)}
.jackpot-tier__icon{position:absolute;top:-26px;width:52px}
.jackpot-tier__name{font:700 22px Poppins,sans-serif;color:var(--tier)}
.jackpot-tier__amount{font:700 22px Inter,sans-serif;color:#fff;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.jackpot-tier--grand{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.15)}
/* --tier: #FF3FD0 mini · #FFC531 grand · #19C8FF major */
Section · feature row

High RTP Games

LayerSpec
LayoutInfo panel (≈ 34% width) then four game cards. 28px after the panel, 16px between cards.
Info panelFill linear-gradient(120deg,#130620,#04121C). 2px cyan border with a cyan → purple glow, 16px radius.
Headline figure96%+ as HTML text, Poppins 800, ≈ 64px, gold #FFD21F with a warm glow text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,150,0,.75). Centred in the left half of the panel. No laurel and no extra words.
ChecklistTop Payout Rates · Higher Win Potential · Player Favorites. 22px green check circles #1CF11D, white 14px / 600.
Game card≈ 1.15 : 1, 14px radius, 2px accent border (amber, red, green, blue-violet).
RTP badgeBottom centre, pill with 2px #00F8E7 outline, translucent fill #00191CC9, cyan 15px / 800 text.
RTP values must come from the provider for the exact game version you host. RTP is a long-run average, so "Higher Win Potential" should be checked with compliance before launch.
Section · tile row · new in v6

New Games

Eight portrait tiles (7 : 9) in one row, 14px apart. This is the densest row on the page. Each tile is one saturated colour: the art's background matches the border, so the tile reads as a block of colour.

Border: 2px, a lighter tint of the tile colour, with a 16px radius and a glow in the same colour. The NEW badge is HTML, pinned 10px from the top-right corner. The game logo is in the lower third of the art.

Put tiles of the same colour apart. Lucky Baccarat C (green) and B (pink) sit next to each other because they differ in colour, not just in letter.

Section · banner · new in v6

VIP Club banner

A 130px banner across the full container, with no section header. 2px neon-edge border, 16px radius, split glow and the VIP banner gradient fill. From left to right: a gold crown (art), VIP CLUB in 48px / 800 italic white, a two-line pitch in 18px / 500 white ("Unlock Exclusive Rewards, Higher Bonuses, and Premium Perks!"), the Explore VIP Club button, and a second crown. Keep the crowns as separate transparent images so the banner can stretch.

Section · logo grid · moved in v6

Game Providers

Tiles ≈ 205 × 64 with 12px gaps, a 10px radius, the provider-tile gradient and a 1px #12304F border. Logos are SVGs in their brand colours or white, centred with object-fit:contain, at most 40px high and 70% of the tile's width. On hover, the border turns cyan with a soft cyan glow.

Order: Hacksaw, Games Global, Pragmatic Play, Playson, Novomatic, Alamba · InOut, PG Soft, 3 Oaks, VoltEnt, Shady Lady, Happy Duck · Spribe, Penguin King, Animo, Big Daddy, Fantasma, Icon21.

Only show providers you have a live contract with, using logos from their media kits.
Section · tool · new in v6

AI Game Search

AI Game SearchTell us what you want to play… e.g., "slots with high RTP"

A full-width pill, ≈ 76px tall, with a 2px search-edge gradient border and a purple glow. Fill #070C26. Left: a cyan sparkle icon and "AI Game Search" in 20px / 700 white. A 1px divider, then the input with placeholder text in 14px muted. Right: the magenta search button. The input must be a real labelled <input>.

Section · support · new in v6

FAQ

Tabs · ≈ 270px column

Plain white 15px / 600 labels, 26px apart. The active tab gets a violet #322571 fill, a 1.5px #8B5CFF border, 10px radius and a soft violet glow.

Accordion

Heading "Frequently Asked Questions", 30px / 600, centred over the column. Items have a 1px #2A3A58 border, 10px radius, 10px gap. Question in 15px / 600 white with a +/− icon on the right. The open item shows its answer in 14px muted, indented 16px.

Replace the placeholder copy. The current questions ("Can we integrate this with our existing systems?", tabs "Integration" and "Payment") are B2B template text. Use player questions instead, for example: What are Gold Coins and Sweeps Coins? · How do I redeem Sweeps Coins? · Which states can play? · How do I get free coins? · Is my account secure? Suggested tabs: General · Coins · Redemptions · Account & Security · Support.
Section · content

SEO content block

Everything is centred. The heading is 34px / 600 white, with the key phrase in magenta #F032F4. Under it, two lines of 14px muted body text (max 900px wide), then the Continue Reading button, which expands the full article in place. Keep the expanded text in the HTML so search engines can read it.

Replace the placeholder copy. The paragraph is about budgeting and retirement planning. Write real sweepstakes casino copy here: what the site is, how free play works, game variety and safe play.
Section · site chrome · new in v6

Footer & legal bar

PartSpec
Top edgeA 1px glowing violet line across the full width.
Ground#060F26, 48px top padding.
LogoWordmark, 28px / 800 white, top left.
ColumnsGAMES, REWARDS, SUPPORT. Headings 14px / 700 uppercase white; links 14px muted with 1.9 line height; hover turns cyan.
Newsletter card≈ 400 × 165. 1.5px #E03BA8 border, 16px radius, pink glow, dark fill #070C20. Copy 14px muted, then a pink pill input #EC097D with a white mail icon button on the right.
Legal barFull-bleed hot pink #F80180, 56px. Left: All Rights Reserved. Centre: © 2026 ONLINE CASINO (bold). Right: Find Us on Social Media + Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube icons. All white.
All Rights Reserved© 2026 ONLINE CASINOFind Us on Social Media
Add before launch: No Purchase Necessary · Sweepstakes Rules · Terms · Privacy · Responsible Social Gameplay · age requirement (18+ or 21+ depending on your rules) · list of excluded states. The legal bar is a natural place for a one-line version.
Part 4

Build notes

Build

Responsive

WidthGutter3-up rows4-up rowsNew GamesProvidersHigh RTP
≥ 144075px3486 × 3panel + 4
1024–143932px346 + scroll6 × 3panel + 4
768–102324px2 + scroll3 + scroll4 + scroll4 × 5panel full width, 4 below
< 76816px1.15 visible, swipe2 visible, swipe2.5 visible, swipe3 × 6panel, then 2 × 2

The Jackpots banner stacks on tablet and mobile: text and buttons first, then the wolf art as a shorter strip, then the three prize boxes in one row (Grand in the middle, still largest). Below 400px the boxes become a 3-column row of smaller tiles with the icon inside.

On mobile, every carousel row scrolls sideways with scroll snap, and a partly visible card hints that there is more. The arrows hide below 768px, but View All stays. The hero headline drops to 44–52px, the art moves behind the text with a dark overlay, and the Active Players card hides. The category nav scrolls. Character cards switch to the 1.65 : 1 crop. Keep all touch targets at least 44px.

Build · US sweepstakes

Sweepstakes wording

The design is final, but some labels are written for a real-money casino. A US sweepstakes site sells Gold Coins and gives Sweeps Coins as a free bonus, so the copy should say that. These are suggested swaps for your legal team to confirm. They don't change the layout.

WhereOn the designSuggested
Header buttonDepositGet Coins / Buy Coins
Wallet$100.00Two balances with a toggle: GC 250,000 · SC 25.00
News ticker50% up to $1,000Coin package amounts (GC + free SC)
Feature rowBIG WINSBIG PRIZES or keep, if legal approves
Footer linkDeposit & PayoutsPurchases & Redemptions
Footer linkResponsible GamingResponsible Social Gameplay
FAQ tabPaymentCoins & Redemptions

The Welcome Bonus card and the Jackpots prize boxes already use the right model: "SIGN UP 10K GC + 1 SC · SPEND $9.99 25K GC + 25 SC" and amounts in SC. Use that pattern for every offer and prize.

CSS tokens

Paste this into styles/tokens.css. The component CSS in this guide uses these names.

  --h1:400 64px/1.1 var(--f-head); --h2:400 56px/1.1 var(--f-head);
  --h3:400 40px/1.15 var(--f-head); --h4:400 32px/1.2 var(--f-head);
  --s1:700 28px/1.3 var(--f-display); --s2:400 24px/1.35 var(--f-display); --s3:400 20px/1.4 var(--f-display);

}
.card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1.5px solid var(--accent,var(--magenta));
  border-radius:var(--r-card);box-shadow:0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,var(--magenta)) 60%,transparent);
  transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,var(--magenta)) 80%,transparent)}
.card img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--cols,4),minmax(0,1fr));gap:var(--gap)}
@media(max-width:1023px){.row{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}
  .row>*{flex:0 0 calc(100% / var(--cols-tab,2.15));scroll-snap-align:start}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
